title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1237: Back in time (3)

section.p: While the stone statue was feeling doubtful.
In the other realms.
Several incomparably ancient existences were slowly sending their willpower out of their realm entrances to observe the ongoing conflict.
Devil Realm.
After a short observation, the Devil Emperor frowned and sank into thought.
Divine Realm.
The Divine Emperor attempted to read the future, but all he saw in his vision was a blanket of dusky chaos. He frowned. Would this battle favor them or not?
Immortal Realm.
The Ancient Immortal King was contemplating in silence. He wasn’t able to see anything as his tendril of willpower had vanished right after it left the realm entrance.
This wasn’t the first time it had happened.
Indeed, it had happened several times in recent years.

As long as he did not leave the realm personally, something like that would happen. It was becoming increasingly hard for him to maintain contact with those outside the realm. As the Ancient Immortal King, his willpower was incredibly powerful. He could easily observe the Myriad Realms by sending his willpower alone. But that had not been possible in recent years.
His willpower had been vanishing into thin air. Not a tiny bit would remain. He frowned as he tried to read the future as well. He kept feeling jittery for no apparent reason.
This had been ongoing for years. Just what was going on?
Outside the Immortal Realm.

A big, furry ball was floating in the boundless void. She was in a good mood after eating a large mouthful of willpower. Over the past three hundred years, she had eaten such a meal a few dozen times. And she was still not tired of the delicious flavor of this willpower.

As far as she was concerned, three hundred years would go by in the blink of an eye. Thus, she felt great having so many delicious meals in such a short period of time. As for entering the realm to eat more… no thanks. She preferred staying outside. It would be too dangerous to enter.
That Tiangu guy was still quite strong. It was even possible that Tiangu was now the strongest in the Myriad Realms. Thus, it was far better to continue eating outside the realm instead.
Suddenly, the silhouette of a…ball appeared beside her.
“Oh, you’re here as well, Husband?”
The big furball looked at the newly arrived big furball and greeted him casually. She sounded like she had only been out doing groceries instead of out for many, many years.
The big furball nodded his entire body blankly and said, “Are you waiting to eat Tiangu?”
“Yeah. He’s so yummy!”
The big furball thought about it and said, “Tiangu won’t be so easy to eat. Why don’t we eat something else instead?”
The big furball’s tiny limb stretched out of his furry body and pointed at a certain River of Time. That was the River of Time used by the immortal king in the Human Realm to summon his bodies over.

As far as the big furball was concerned, every immortal was incredibly yummy. The older one was, the more flavorful one would be. And how convenient was it that a certain immortal was trying to move through the River of Time.
The female furball thought about it and asked, “But what about Tiangu?”
“Put him aside for now. We eat him when he leaves. If he doesn’t leave, we wait here and eat the others. The immortals are yummy. Eat enough and Tiangu will come out.”
The female furball nodded her body in agreement. Wow, her husband was indeed smarter than her.
Instantly, the two furballs vanished into the River of Time nearby.
Meanwhile, the immortal king’s two tri-life bodies were still heading toward the Human Realm.
Suddenly, his heart started palpitating.

What? Was there a danger waiting for him in the Human Realm? Yes, it was dangerous previously. But his three bodies were about to become one. At that time, nothing in the Human Realm would have the ability to endanger him.
That thought had barely crossed his mind when he heard a voice, “Husband, one for us each. He has two bodies.”
“Alright.”
And then…nothingness.
The two furballs had no difficulty dealing with an immortal king with only two tri-life bodies.
They only needed to each take a bite and that was it.

No massive phenomenon was generated as the future body of the immortal king was still alive and well. The two furballs vanished again with a flicker. After the good meal, the female furball was full of joy. She was also full of praise for her amazing husband. Right after her husband arrived, she got herself a delicious meal.
Human Realm.
The immortal king was still busy summoning his two bodies. He could feel it. They were near.

He was overjoyed as he dreamed about the beautiful future where he would first kill Zhu Tiandao before snatching the Culture Tomb. After all, he would be the first to assemble his complete body in the Human Realm.
Fiery Sea was already dead.
Wan Tiansheng, someone capable of killing Invincibles, was as good as crippled.
First Profound had yet to complete his dao affirmation while the Yellow Department head’s summoning was being intercepted.
He was the first. He would be the strongest person present before long. But abruptly, his expression changed as his future body shook intensely. Cracks appeared all over his body.
Not far away, Zhu Tiandao cursed, “Shameless bastard! Don’t even dream of luring me over with this act! I haven’t even affirmed my dao!”
How shameless.
The immortal king was actually pretending to be gravely injured to lure him over. Did the immortal king think that he wasn’t aware of the two tri-life bodies who were on the verge of arriving?
Finally, the two bodies arrived.
To be precise, one corpse and one carrier treasure arrived.
The corpse was the present body while the carrier treasure came from the past body.
The two furballs did not care about carrier treasures. They only cared about their meal.
Zhu Tiandao was stunned. What was this?
What trick was this? Why did the immortal king summon a carrier treasure and a corpse over?
Zhu Tiandao was dumbfounded.
The immortal king was staring blankly while coughing blood. He had lived for thousands of years, but he had never felt like this before.
Where were his tri-life bodies?
Where were his present and past bodies?
Did he summon the wrong thing?
That shouldn’t be possible.
Why?
That question would remain unanswered for eternity. Despite his stupefaction, Zhu Tiandao was still able to take the appropriate action.
What even was this?
An immortal king had suddenly lost two of his bodies. His sole remaining body was receiving a massive backlash from the sudden loss. He was on the verge of death.
As Zhu Tiandao prepared himself to kill the immortal king, Great Han King and the others were still fighting bitterly.
Meanwhile, Su Yu was speaking to his mayor’s medallion with surprise, “Lord Stone Statue?”
What joke was this? Sending a voice transmission across realms?
Holy shit!
Was this medallion so impressive?
“Stop taking in death qi.”

Finally, Su Yu was sure that he wasn’t hearing things. Overjoyed, he hurriedly said, “Lord, I will be rushing to the Allheaven Battlefield soon. Dozens of Invincibles are trying to kill me. Lord, I beseech you to grace me with your presence and avenge your loyal subordinate!”
“Dozens of Invincibles? Where?”
In the sky.
The stone statue looked around and rolled his eyes. There weren’t even that many Invincibles around.
“Lord, I’m serious! I’ll be heading to the Allheaven Battlefield soon…”
“Oh, but I’m not there.”
“I can go to the ancient city…”
“I’m not in the city.”
Su Yu blanked out. An utterly ridiculous thought appeared in his mind as he said, “Are you in the Human Realm, Lord?”
Due to the distraction, he was sent flying by Zhan Wushuang with a punch. But he was too distracted to care.
The stone statue said, “Beat him up! He punched you! Why aren’t you punching him back?”
“Lord…you’re in the Human Realm?”
Su Yu was ecstatic.
“Lord, I beseech you to sever that River of Time. The one Great Han King is using. The moment he returns with his main body, we’re all dead…”
The stone statue looked at the said River of Time.
He stared, and stared, and stared…
It was so…stable.
Terrifyingly stable.
Sever his ass.
It was protected by so many Invincibles.
Even a Pseudo Emperor might have a hard time severing it in this state.
In that case, wasn’t his mayor as good as dead? No, wait. With him here, his mayor wouldn’t die. As for the others…well, that did not concern him.
He replied, “Calm down. You won’t die.”
“But Lord, if he manages to return, the others will die. Lord, I beg you to do me this favor. Please. I will work harder for you in the future…”
Grandstar ignored Su Yu. He looked at the Allheaven Battlefield again as he muttered, “Yet another one has succeeded.”

A second human had completed his dao affirmation. He was none other than Zhou Polong. To be precise, he was near full completion. An Invincible was trying to stop him, but the Invincible found himself trapped by a character of Zhou Polong.
Interesting.

Generally, multiple Invincibles would be required to kill a genius of this caliber. But most Invincibles were distracted elsewhere. For example, there were nearly twenty Invincibles around Xia Longwu.

As for the Yellow Department head, about four Invincibles were interfering with his tri-life bodies, stopping them from entering the Human Realm. There were also roughly twenty Invincibles in the boundless void near the Human Realm.
All in all, about eighty myriad race Invincibles were involved in this conflict against humanity.
In fact, including those in the Human Realm and those Su Yu was keeping occupied by fighting the Invincible-powered young geniuses, over a hundred myriad race Invincibles were involved.

This was the first time in centuries so many Invincibles were deployed for a single conflict. And they weren’t even that successful. The humans were still able to affirm their dao with very little interference.
Great Han King alone had monopolized the attention of the majority of these Invincibles.

The stone statue was still feeling very doubtful. In fact, the Pseudo Emperors of the major races were feeling the same. Something felt off. The humans were being allowed to affirm their dao with far less interference than expected.

They wondered if they should send more Invincibles to deal with these human Pseudo Invincibles. Also, Great Han King had attracted way too many Invincibles. That was not supposed to happen. Including the human Invincibles, there were about seventy Invincibles around Great Han King. Great Han King alone was keeping so many Invincibles occupied.

At the same time, the stone statue was also wondering about Immortal King Tiangu. Where was that old immortal? Why wasn’t he observing the battle like everyone else? Oh…right. Suddenly, the stone statue remembered that he had sent a certain furball over. Nothing bad would happen, right?
Hopefully.

As his mind wandered about, his gaze landed on the Yellow Department head, or to be precise, Zhu Tianfang. He blanked out. Zhu Tianfang was also trying to assemble his main body, but his River of Time had unfurled far away from Great Han King’s.
It almost felt like he was afraid of interfering with Great Han King’s River of Time.
The stone statue shook his head in confusion. Had his intelligence dropped after staying in the holy city for so many years? Why did he find himself so easily confused after finally leaving the city?

As his gaze landed on the spreading multicolored rays of light, he was only certain about one thing. Humanity was about to produce their second new Invincible for the day. This round of dao affirmation seemed far smoother than all the previous rounds of human dao affirmation.
More and more people were starting to feel suspicious. It hadn’t even been that long yet humanity had produced two new Invincibles. Wasn’t this a tad too fast?
This was abnormal.
Generally, one would take at least several days to complete a dao affirmation.
The stone statue continued shaking his head in confusion.
Maybe his big brother could see more?

These humans were scheming too much, to the point he was totally confused. If they were unhappy about something, they should just fight it out. In the past, the humans were very good at fighting. Why were the modern humans so obsessed with scheming instead?

Even while he was feeling utterly confused, the stone statue did not forget to send Su Yu a voice transmission, “It won’t happen so soon. What’s the rush? Great Han King is still busy fighting Great Zhou King and the others. Nearly seventy Invincibles are involved. Great Zhou King is so furious he’s probably going to start coughing blood from sheer anger soon…”
Su Yu was stunned. Great Zhou King? Coughing blood from anger? Was that old turtle even capable of that?
Wasn’t the old turtle supposed to be so calm he would remain in control of his emotions even if Great Qin King himself was the traitor?
Was he so saddened by Great Han King’s betrayal?
Was he that close to Great Han King?
Su Yu blanked out. Nearly seventy Invincibles. Great Zhou King and Great Han King in a fight, dragging many other Invincibles into the fight. What?

“You humans have two new Invincibles. Wow, would you look at that? What’s his name? Zhou Polong? He’s so strong right after his dao affirmation. Look at how far he sent that myriad race Invincible flying. Yo…Zhou Potian is going to finish his dao affirmation soon as well. Impressive, Zhou Family!”
The stone statue narrated like he was watching a great show, feeding Su Yu with the latest updates.
As for Su Yu, he was stunned again and again.
Three new Invincibles in such a short time?
How was that possible?

Wasn’t dao affirmation supposed to be slow and dangerous? One even needed to wait for the Invincibles to kill each other and drop some carrier treasures. In fact, that was how most people would collect sufficient carrier treasures to complete their dao affirmation.
Su Yu was unaware that Junior Zhou King was also the Profound Department head of the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion.
Carrier treasures were rare, but they could still be found in the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion.

Conveniently, Liu Wushen had also started his dao affirmation with two carrier treasures prepared. At the moment, everyone else was too occupied to think too deeply about that. Most suspected that he was merely lucky.
Boundless void.
The furious Great Han King was giving the two Zhou Kings a beating, forcing the two to pull back repeatedly while coughing blood.
He was determined to return to the Human Realm.
“Back in Time.”
With a roar, Junior Zhou King returned to annoy him like an immortal cockroach. That further angered Great Han King.
“Father, don’t…don’t kill him…stop fighting…”
Liu Wushen was still roaring madly as he tried to approach his father, “No, Father, don’t do this! If you do this, everything will be over for humanity! Don’t do this!”
“I’m not going to harm humanity. I’m only going to kill those from the multiple character faction.”
Liu Wushen said with desperation, “Father, turn back while you still can…”
His voice contained boundless sorrow.
It sounded like he was on the verge of killing himself just to change his father’s mind.
As Great Han King made another attempt to return to the Human Realm, Junior Zhou King roared, “Back in Time!”
Great Han King was brought back yet again. Furious, he bellowed, “Myriad races, assist me and kill them all! They’re forcing my hand! I need help!”
